title: Who needs sugar
paragraphs: There's no doubt that I have a sweet tooth – I crave cakes and biscuits and could happily finish off a bar of chocolate in minutes. I'm sure I'm not alone, the sweet sugary taste is addictive but the big question is, is it bad for me? I think I know the answer!

Sugar is everywhere. Even if sweet stuff isn't your thing it's hard to avoid. In the UK, we consume over two million tonnes of sugar every year but often we don’t know we’re eating it. There have been many health campaigns, telling us about the dangers of consuming too much sugar and we have probably learnt that it should be eaten in moderation but we may be unaware of the added sugar we consume that's found in the food and drink we think of as healthy or savoury, such as low-fat yoghurt and sauces.

The obvious negative effect of eating sugar is on our dental health – tooth decay is a big problem in children, partly caused by drinking too many sugary drinks. Public Health England claims a child in England has a tooth removed in hospital every 10 minutes due to preventable decay. But even if you can escape the dentist's drill, there are more worrying negative effects - repeatedly eating too much sugar can lead to weight gain and even obesity, leading to an increased risk of diabetes, heart disease and liver disease.

So what can we do to cut down on our sugar intake? Well, there are low-sugar recipes you can try and apparently there are alternative foods to help us beat the sweet cravings. But potentially the most effective method is to tax the sugar we consume. It's what several countries have been doing for a while and the UK has recently jumped on the bandwagon, by forcing manufacturers to pay a levy on the high-sugar drinks they sell. It's up to the manufacturers if they pass the cost on to consumers.

But will it work? University of Bedfordshire nutrition expert Dr Daniel Bailey told BBC Online that: "The increase in tax placed on soft drinks will make products more expensive, but will this actually discourage people from buying them?" Maybe if you're addicted to the stuff, you'd accept paying more to buy it. But in the UK at least, several soft drinks companies have already reduced the sugar content of their products to avoid the tax. Obviously it's better to do something rather than nothing to help improve the well-being of everyone. But with so many temptations out there, I'm not sure how easy it will be to cure my sweet tooth.

vocabulary.entry: sweet tooth /swiːt tuːθ/ n. 爱吃甜食的嗜好
vocabulary.example: She has a real sweet tooth and can't resist chocolate.
vocabulary.translation: 她真的很爱吃甜食，无法抗拒巧克力。

vocabulary.entry: moderation /ˌmɒdəˈreɪʃn/ n. 适度，节制
vocabulary.example: Everything should be eaten in moderation.
vocabulary.translation: 任何食物都应该适量食用。

vocabulary.entry: added sugar /ˈædɪd ˈʃʊɡə(r)/ n. 添加糖（食品加工中额外添加的糖）
vocabulary.example: This cereal contains a lot of added sugar.
vocabulary.translation: 这种麦片含有大量添加糖。

vocabulary.entry: Public Health England /ˈpʌblɪk helθ ˈɪŋɡlənd/ n. 英国公共卫生部门
vocabulary.example: Public Health England has issued new guidelines on sugar intake.
vocabulary.translation: 英国公共卫生部门发布了有关糖分摄入的新指南。

vocabulary.entry: obesity /əʊˈbiːsəti/ n. 肥胖
vocabulary.example: Obesity is linked to a range of health problems.
vocabulary.translation: 肥胖与一系列健康问题相关。

vocabulary.entry: tax /tæks/ v. 对……征税（政府对商品或服务征收的费用）
vocabulary.example: The government plans to tax sugary drinks.
vocabulary.translation: 政府计划对含糖饮料征税。

vocabulary.entry: jump on the bandwagon /dʒʌmp ɒn ðə ˈbændwæɡən/ phr. 赶潮流（跟随流行趋势）
vocabulary.example: Many brands are jumping on the bandwagon of plant-based products.
vocabulary.translation: 许多品牌正赶植物基产品的潮流。

vocabulary.entry: levy /ˈlevi/ n. 税赋，征税
vocabulary.example: A new levy on plastic bags has been introduced.
vocabulary.translation: 一项新的塑料袋税已经实施。

vocabulary.entry: discourage /dɪsˈkʌrɪdʒ/ v. 阻止，使气馁
vocabulary.example: High prices may discourage consumers from buying.
vocabulary.translation: 高价可能会阻止消费者购买。

vocabulary.entry: content /ˈkɒntent/ n. 含量，内容
vocabulary.example: Check the fat content on the nutrition label.
vocabulary.translation: 查看营养标签上的脂肪含量。

vocabulary.entry: well-being /wel ˈbiːɪŋ/ n. 健康，福祉
vocabulary.example: Regular exercise is important for physical and mental well-being.
vocabulary.translation: 定期锻炼对身心健康很重要。

vocabulary.entry: temptations /tempˈteɪʃnz/ n. 诱惑，引诱（复数）
vocabulary.example: She tried to resist the temptations of fast food.
vocabulary.translation: 她试图抗拒快餐的诱惑。

vocabulary.entry: crave /kreɪv/ v. 渴望，热望
vocabulary.example: I'm craving something sweet after dinner.
vocabulary.translation: 晚饭后我渴望吃点甜食。

vocabulary.entry: addictive /əˈdɪktɪv/ adj. 使人上瘾的
vocabulary.example: Some online games can be highly addictive.
vocabulary.translation: 一些网络游戏可能极易上瘾。

vocabulary.entry: consume /kənˈsjuːm/ v. 消耗，消费
vocabulary.example: We consume more energy in winter.
vocabulary.translation: 我们在冬天消耗更多能源。

vocabulary.entry: savoury /ˈseɪvəri/ adj. 咸香的，非甜的
vocabulary.example: I prefer savoury snacks to sweet ones.
vocabulary.translation: 比起甜食，我更喜欢咸香的零食。

vocabulary.entry: dental health /ˈdentl helθ/ n. 牙齿健康
vocabulary.example: Good dental health requires regular brushing and flossing.
vocabulary.translation: 良好的牙齿健康需要定期刷牙和使用牙线。

vocabulary.entry: tooth decay /tuːθ dɪˈkeɪ/ n. 蛀牙，龋齿
vocabulary.example: Too much sugar can lead to tooth decay.
vocabulary.translation: 过多的糖会导致蛀牙。

vocabulary.entry: diabetes /ˌdaɪəˈbiːtiːz/ n. 糖尿病
vocabulary.example: Type 2 diabetes is often associated with poor diet.
vocabulary.translation: 2型糖尿病通常与不良饮食相关。

vocabulary.entry: cut down on /kʌt daʊn ɒn/ phr. 减少，削减
vocabulary.example: I need to cut down on my sugar intake.
vocabulary.translation: 我需要减少糖分摄入。

vocabulary.entry: recipes /ˈresəpiz/ n. 食谱，烹饪法（复数）
vocabulary.example: She collects recipes from magazines.
vocabulary.translation: 她从杂志上收集食谱。

vocabulary.entry: alternative /ɔːlˈtɜːnətɪv/ adj. 替代的，可供选择的
vocabulary.example: There are many alternative milk products available.
vocabulary.translation: 有许多替代奶制品可供选择。

vocabulary.entry: cravings /ˈkreɪvɪŋz/ n. 渴望，热望（复数）
vocabulary.example: She has cravings for salty foods during pregnancy.
vocabulary.translation: 她怀孕期间渴望吃咸味食物。
